overhead-dialogue.npc: Gather round, one and all! It's time for the Darkmeyer Auctions!
We've got quite the lineup for you today! So, let's get started!
First up, a 37 year old male from sector four!
He's got plenty of blood in him, and he'll keep your home clean of any mess!
Let's start the bidding at 1,000 coins! Do I have 1,000?
1,000 coins to the vyre at the back! Do I have 2,000?
2,000 for the lady in red! Anyone for 3,000?
I have 3,000! But do I have 4,000?
Anyone for 4,000?
3,000 going once!
3,000 going twice!
Sold to the vyre at the back!
Right then! Next we have a 22 year old female from sector six!
She's young and filled with optimism! Perfect for those who enjoy a taste of hope!
We'll start with 5,000 for this one! Do I have any takers!
5,000 coins for the lady at the front! How about 6,000?
I have 6,000! Who wants 7,000!
10,000! We have a bid of 10,000! You lot really want this one! Anyone up for 12,000?
Anyone for any more? 13,000?
12,000 going once!
12,000 going twice!
Sold for 12,000 coins! Enjoy!
Okay, finally we have a 41 year old male from sector three!
Careful! This one is feisty! In fact, we've had to put him in a cage!
If you can put him in his place though, you're in for a treat! His blood is the sweetest around!
We'll begin with 4,000 coins!
I have 4,000! But do I have 5,000?
5,000 coins to the vyre in red! Do I have 6,000?
6,000 coins! Looks like we have a competition here! Let's take it to 7,000!
We're at 7,000! But will it go higher? 8,000 coins?
7,000 going once!
7,000 going twice!
Sold to the vyre in red!
Well there you have it! That's all for now from the Darkmeyer Auctions!
Fear not though. We'll be back with more, very soon!
